```{r setup}
if(!require(readr)){install.packages('readr')}
library(readr) 
if(!require(tidyverse)){install.packages('tidyverse')}
library(tidyverse) 

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/Volumes/fsmresfiles/MSS/Schleider_Lab/jslab/ED SSI Delphi Study")
setwd("/Volumes/fsmresfiles/MSS/Schleider_Lab/jslab/ED SSI Delphi Study")

#Data exported with values (not labels) and all variables assigned character class for later conversion to correct class; first two rows with item labeling manually removed prior to import; identifying information (e.g., emails) removed

phase1_step1 <- read_csv("Data/phase1_step1.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) 

phase1_step2 <- read_csv("Data/phase1_step2.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) 

phase2_round1_withduplicate <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round1_withduplicate.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c")) 

phase2_round1_deduplicated <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round1_deduplicated.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

phase2_round2 <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round2.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

phase2_round3 <- read_csv("Data/phase2_round3.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
```

```{r phase 1 cleaning}
#Identify demographics variables with multiple select options
multi_vars_phase1 <- c("aim1s1_race", "aim1s1_gender",                                           
                "aim1s1_identify_eds", "aim1s1_ed_dx_place", "aim1s1_ed_care_prov",         
                "aim1s1_ED_type", "aim1s1_lo_ED_dx_plc",                                    
                "aim1s1_group_focus_c", "aim1s1_job_ed_type",                               
                "aim1s1_group_focus_r", "aim1s1_res_ed_type", "aim1s1_ed_res_topics")       

#Apply helper function with multiple select variables
for(v in multi_vars_phase1) {
  dummies_phase1 <- split_multiselect(phase1_step1, v)
  phase1_step1 <- phase1_step1 %>%
    left_join(dummies_phase1, by = "Participant_ID", relationship = "one-to-one")
}

#Make all necessary variables factors
phase1_step1 <- phase1_step1 %>%
  mutate(across(c(aim1s1_age_group, aim1s1_expert_group, aim1s1_sexual_orient, aim1s1_education_lev,
                  aim1s1_time_strugled, aim1s1_ed_sym_length, aim1s1_ed_dx_age,
                  aim1s1_ED_patnt_rel, aim1s1_ED_trmt_invol, aim1s1_ED_trmt_role, aim1s1_ED_sym_time,
                  aim1s1_cln_job_span, aim1s1_job_tim_on_ED, aim1s1_role_title, aim1s1_workplace, aim1s1_job_clients,
                  aim1s1_res_car_lengt, aim1s1_amt_on_ed_res, aim1s1_research_role, aim1s1_res_workplace),
                as.factor))

#Make all necessary variables numeric
phase1_step1 <- phase1_step1 %>%
  mutate(across(c(aim1s1_age_exact, aim1s1_ssi_familiar, aim1s1_ssi_view),
                as.numeric))
```

```{r phase 2 cleaning}
#Add aim2r1_expert_group column to Phase 2 Round 2 data 
phase2_round2 <- phase2_round2 %>%
  left_join(
    phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
      select(Participant_ID, aim2r1_expert_group),
    by = "Participant_ID"
  )

#Add aim2r1_expert_group column to Phase 2 Round 3 data
phase2_round3 <- phase2_round3 %>%
  left_join(
    phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
      select(Participant_ID, aim2r1_expert_group),
    by = "Participant_ID"
  )

#Rename Phase 2 Round 3 columns for consistent bridge idea labels 
phase2_round3 <- phase2_round3 %>%
  rename(
    aim2r1_prvntion_4  = points_1,
    aim2r1_prvntion_6  = points_2,
    aim2r1_prvntion_11 = points_3,
    aim2r1_prvntion_14 = points_4,
    aim2r1_prvntion_15 = points_5,
    aim2r1_ident_2     = points_6,
    aim2r1_ident_3     = points_7,
    aim2r1_ident_5     = points_8,
    aim2r1_ir_1        = points_9,
    aim2r1_ir_10       = points_10,
    aim2r1_ir_11       = points_11,
    aim2r1_treatmnt_1  = points_12,
    aim2r1_treatmnt_9  = points_13,
    aim2r1_psorsrpt_1  = points_14,
    aim2r1_psorsrpt_7  = points_15,
    aim2r1_psorsrpt_10 = points_16
  )

#Create categorical variables for the bridge items
phase2_round1_withduplicate <- phase2_round1_withduplicate %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(contains("aim2r1_expert_group"),
      contains("aim2r1_prvntion_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ident_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ir_"),
      contains("aim2r1_treatmnt_"),
      contains("aim2r1_psorsrpt_")),
    as.factor))

phase2_round1_deduplicated <- phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(contains("aim2r1_expert_group"),
      contains("aim2r1_prvntion_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ident_"),
      contains("aim2r1_ir_"),
      contains("aim2r1_treatmnt_"),
      contains("aim2r1_psorsrpt_")),
    as.factor))

#Identify demographics variables with multiple select options (same as above)
multi_vars_phase2 <- c("aim2r1_race", "aim2r1_gender",                                           
                "aim2r1_identify_eds", "aim2r1_ed_dx_place", "aim2r1_ed_care_prov",         
                "aim2r1_ED_type", "aim2r1_lo_ED_dx_plc",                                    
                "aim2r1_group_focus_c", "aim2r1_job_ed_type",                               
                "aim2r1_group_focus_r", "aim2r1_res_ed_type", "aim2r1_ed_res_topics")       

#Apply helper function with multiple select variables (same as above)
for(v in multi_vars_phase2) {
  dummies_phase2 <- split_multiselect(phase2_round1_deduplicated, v)
  phase2_round1_deduplicated <- phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
    left_join(dummies_phase2, by = "Participant_ID", relationship = "one-to-one")
}

#Make all necessary variables factors
phase2_round1_deduplicated <- phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
  mutate(across(c(aim2r1_age_group, aim2r1_expert_group, aim2r1_sexual_orient, aim2r1_education_lev,
                  aim2r1_time_strugled, aim2r1_ed_sym_length, aim2r1_ed_dx_age,
                  aim2r1_ED_patnt_rel, aim2r1_ED_trmt_invol, aim2r1_ED_trmt_role, aim2r1_ED_sym_time,
                  aim2r1_cln_job_span, aim2r1_job_tim_on_ED, aim2r1_role_title, aim2r1_workplace, aim2r1_job_clients,
                  aim2r1_res_car_lengt, aim2r1_amt_on_ed_res, aim2r1_research_role, aim2r1_res_workplace),
                as.factor))

#Make all necessary variables numeric
phase2_round1_deduplicated <- phase2_round1_deduplicated %>%
  mutate(across(c(aim2r1_age_exact, aim2r1_ssi_familiar, aim2r1_ssi_view),
                as.numeric))
```
